what: You hear a recording. A beep replaces the last word or words. You choose the option that completes it.
tests: Listening: predicting the end of a talk from its meaning.

scoring.note: Pearson says it is scored as either correct or incorrect.

strategy: Follow the topic and the direction of the argument.
Near the end, think about what word would naturally come next.
Choose the option that fits both the meaning and the grammar.
example_prompt: '...so if we want cleaner air in the city, we need fewer [beep]' (cars / trees / parks)

strong.why: Fits the argument about cleaner air.

medium.why: A word from the topic, but the meaning is opposite.

mistakes: Losing focus before the end of the recording.
Choosing a word just because it was heard earlier.
